description: One DRN for the 12 months of the two FMAM cycles and ONDJ, without JJAS, with the month position and the cycle as inputs (scripts/pooled_all_benchmark.py, docs/54 section 3h).
pathway: B: rainfall-distribution models from the raw ensemble, pooled over the months of the FMAM and ONDJ cycles (JJAS left out)
external_note: The four-cycle network is read from neural_all (drn-all-v1), the pooled DRN from neural_pooled2 and EMOS from neural_ext, all with scoring version 2 and the same folds.
